fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) is positioned as the leading memory stock outperforming Micron and Sandisk in 2027, with Q3 2026 revenue surging 328% YoY to $7.9 billion and operating profit increasing 632%, continuing AI-demand-driven growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix holds 29% DRAM market share (second after Samsung), 19% NAND flash share ahead of Micron and Sandisk, and commands 1/3 of the global HBM market, with the HBM market expected to grow to $64.1 billion by 2030.
